meta.title: A second late lead change extends again
gaps: The vocabulary has no operation for an automatic lead-change extension caused by a bid.
QA vendor 3 is not available; only vendor and vendor2 are supported.
The setup does not directly represent a state after a first extension; the plan arranges one with extend_round.
The vocabulary cannot place the bid specifically below QA vendor 3.
The vocabulary cannot wait until the last minute without waiting until the round closes.
An exact additional two-minute extension cannot be asserted because no numeric dynamic comparison or matching time token is available.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: The buyer makes the first extension.
QA vendor 1 places a late bid.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “ending at” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
